# Jobibi — Build Plan v0.1 (revised)

**Status: AUTHORIZED.** Drafted 2026-08-09; revised the same day to reflect the design grill outcomes ([DECISIONS.md](../DECISIONS.md) D10–D18). Authorize phase by phase.

House rules carried into this project: vertical slices over layers (one feature end-to-end, verified running, then the next); commit after each green slice; fast unit tests for domain/pipeline logic, UI verified by running the extension; every slice carries an explicit not-in-scope list.

**Model:** GPT-5.6 Luna for every AI call — drafting, gap-question wording, classification (D5b). Embeddings are gte-small, in-process (D5c).

**What moved, versus v0.1:** the ask path and the sensitive-field check moved *earlier* (into Phase 2); the four-fact intake moved from Phase 4 into Phase 1; capture grew substantially; a golden-set fixture became a hard prerequisite for the core loop.

---

## Phase 1 — Foundation

### ✅ S1. Repo scaffold
Monorepo (pnpm): `apps/extension` (WXT + React + TS + Tailwind), `supabase/`, `packages/shared`. Extension loads in Chrome with a hello-world side panel.
**Done when:** `pnpm dev` produces a loadable extension; side panel opens on any page.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** any backend call, any auth, any form reading.

### ✅ S2. Supabase project + auth
Supabase project (Singapore), schema migrations scaffold, RLS enabled from table zero, `profiles` table. Sign-in from the extension (PKCE flow) works.
**Done when:** a user can sign in from the side panel and their profile row exists; RLS verified with a two-user test.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** memory schema, uploads, any AI call.

### ✅ S3. Document upload + ingestion + four-fact intake
Upload or paste resume/cover letter/transcript (PDF, DOCX, TXT) → extract text → chunk → embed (gte-small, in-process) → `documents` + `memory_chunks`. Cover letters may also be pasted as freetext instead of uploaded (S3b) — resumes and transcripts stay upload-only. Plus a sixty-second intake collecting the four repeating facts — salary expectation, notice period, work authorisation, location — into `sensitive_facts` (D18). Debug list in the panel shows what the memory bank holds.
**Done when:** an uploaded resume is visible as searchable chunks *and* the four facts exist for a new user; unit tests cover chunking and text extraction.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** suggestions, question reading, style profile.

> The intake is here rather than in Phase 4 because D17's sensitive-field detector uses retrieval against typed facts — it needs them to exist from the first session.

> A headless-Chrome verification lane for this slice's UI (pre-sign-in gate through post-sign-in upload/intake/memory-bank) now exists at `scripts/verify-chrome-lane/` — see its README for usage.

## Phase 2 — The core loop

### ✅ S4. JobStreet question extraction + confident mapping
JobStreet adapter: content script detects application-form questions (label, type, context) and the panel lists them live. Each question carries a **mapping** to its input field with a confidence score (D16 groundwork). Fixture-HTML tests for the adapter. Shipped 2026-08-11 as `e423139` (`8480c81`) — live-verified on a real JobStreet application (homepage `0`, Choose documents `1` cover letter, Employer questions `4` with `high 1.0/low 0.5` mappings, tab-aware panel).
**Done when:** opening a real JobStreet application shows its questions in the panel, each with a resolved field and a confidence value.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** drafting, retrieval, capture, any other site.

### ✅ S4.5. Gate fixture — the golden set
~50 hand-written `(question, memory state, expected outcome)` triples spanning all three outcomes, with deliberate coverage of the hard case: strong story, wrong role family. This is the tuning target *and* S5a's test fixture (D15). Shipped 2026-08-11 as `f1ff005` — 50 cases (`18 draft / 16 ask / 16 refuse`) in `packages/shared/src/gate/goldenSet.ts`.
**Done when:** the fixture exists, is committed, and every case has a justified expected outcome.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** any pipeline code. This is data.

> Hard prerequisite for S5a. You cannot calibrate or test a gate without labelled examples, and there are no users yet to produce them.

### ✅ S5a. Suggest endpoint — gate, draft, refuse
Pipeline for one site: normalize → retrieve (hybrid) → **two-axis gate** (question-match + role-match, relative scoring with an absolute floor) → draft via Luna with strict JSON schema → copy card rendering **answer + skeleton** (D14). Refusal is a first-class, tested outcome and never calls the model. Every decision written to `gate_decisions` (D15). Shipped 2026-08-11 as `ac561be` → hotfixed `8c96860` (PR #10, `fm/jobibi-s5a-suggest` + `10bba82`→`8c96860` fixes: `deno.json` zod, `NaN` sanitize, gate `0.04/0.25`, `max_completion_tokens`).
**Done when:** a JobStreet question yields either a grounded copy card carrying both an answer and a skeleton, or the exact refusal message; the golden set passes; drafts respect an explicit length cap.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** the ask path, sensitive handling, Auto-Fill, capture, seen-before.

### ✅ S5b. The ask path
The gate's third outcome, end to end: on relevant-but-thin, Luna words one gap question anchored to a retrieved fact; the panel asks it inline; the answer is stored in `gap_answers`, chunked into `memory_chunks`, and drafting continues (D10). Shipped 2026-08-11 on branch `fm/jobibi-s5b-ask-path`: `supabase/migrations/20260811000001_gap_answers.sql`, `supabase/functions/gap-answer`, gate branching + `SuggestCard.tsx` ask UI. Headed-verified twice pre-commit (static + live against real Supabase); `ROLE_THRESHOLD` recalibrated `0.35 → 0.60` on branch `fm/jobibi-s5b-ask-threshold-recalibration` (live `roleMatch` headed verification `data/jobibi-s5b-live-headed-verification/report.md` §3.1/§6) — see project-build-progress.md, authoritative value in `packages/shared/src/gate/gate.ts`.
**Done when:** a question with a strong story but a mismatched role family produces an anchored one-line question, and answering it yields a draft that uses the new material.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** proactive Grill Me sessions, freshness clocks.

### ✅ S5c. Sensitive fields — always-confirm
`sensitive_facts` handling wired into the pipeline *ahead of* drafting: rule-based detection plus retrieval against the user's typed facts, union semantics (D17). Always-confirm card shows the stored fact with its provenance line ("You said ₱X on your Stripe application, Apr 2026 — still true?"). Confirm/update writes back with a fresh timestamp. Excluded from drafting and Auto-Fill at the pipeline level. Shipped 2026-08-12 on branch `fm/jobibi-s5c-sensitive-fields` (`77afbc4` → `ab8eecf` debug-harness removal → `bc251a8` no-mistakes review fix scoping `factId` lookups by kind → `22e4328` fail-closed check + drop internal debug line from card → `57e9ab1` no-mistakes review fix on the fail-closed query check + confirm-card error state).
**Done when:** salary/notice/visa/relocation questions never reach the drafting step, including when phrased without any keyword from the rule list.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** freshness half-lives, proactive re-confirmation.

### ✅ S6. Capture — the growth loop
Field watching with **re-derived mapping verification** at submit (D16): agreement writes, disagreement drops and logs (to `capture_mismatches`). Captured answers land in `qa_pairs` with `draft_text`, `origin`, and `edit_distance` (D13). Seen-before check surfaces prior answers on near-duplicate questions, with role-match choosing the default presentation and both options always offered (D12). Shipped 2026-08-12 on branch `fm/jobibi-s6-capture-growth-loop` (`711d888` → `6aefda3` no-mistakes review: suggestion-time mapping snapshot, dedupe triggers, fail-closed `mappingVerified`, dedupe near-dup scoring → `1f7fa90` no-mistakes review: flush pending scheduled capture on beforeunload/visibility instead of dropping it).

> **S5b ask-gate `ROLE_THRESHOLD` recalibration** completed on its own branch (`fm/jobibi-s5b-ask-threshold-recalibration`, `0.35 → 0.60`) — see project-build-progress.md; authoritative value in `packages/shared/src/gate/gate.ts`.

**Done when:** answering the same question on a second application surfaces the first answer with its source label; a deliberately broken mapping is caught and drops the write rather than corrupting memory; origin is correctly derived across all three cases.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** style profile distillation.

## Phase 3 — Growth and trust

### S7. LinkedIn Easy Apply + Indeed adapters + generic fallback
Two more adapters plus the label-proximity generic extractor; extraction-failure telemetry. LinkedIn Easy Apply also picks up job-description text opportunistically, since the listing sits behind the modal (D11).

> **Prerequisite satisfied:** S5b ask-gate `ROLE_THRESHOLD` recalibration completed (`0.35 → 0.60` on `fm/jobibi-s5b-ask-threshold-recalibration`); authoritative value in `packages/shared/src/gate/gate.ts`.

⛔ **NOT in this slice:** Workday or any further sites.

> **S7A sensitive storage gate at insert + refuse-card manual-input** completed on its own branch (`fm/jobibi-sensitive-storage-gate-s7a`) — the D17 gate now runs before `gap-answer`/`capture`/`manual-input` inserts too, not only ahead of drafting; see project-build-progress.md and DECISIONS.md D17.

### ✅ S7B. LinkedIn Easy Apply detection scoping
LinkedIn adapter currently does generic page-wide field detection, surfacing nav/filter chrome as false questions. Scope detection to the Easy Apply dialog container and, within it, to the Additional Questions step only — skip contact-info, resume, and review steps, and the underlying search-results page entirely. Within that step, do not specially detect/target a Cover Letter field as an application question (Cover Letter is handled generically via S8's Draft Cover Letter facility) — unless the field is co-located in the same detection step as the real employer questions (same page-level presence signal the adapter uses to find those questions), in which case let it be detected normally with no special-case exclusion.
**Done when:** only genuine Easy Apply Additional-Questions-step fields are detected as questions on LinkedIn, and a co-located cover-letter field in that same step is not specially excluded.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** any other LinkedIn flow (search, profile pages, etc.).

> **S7B LinkedIn Easy Apply detection scoping** completed on its own branch (`fm/jobibi-s7b-linkedin-detection-scoping`) — LinkedIn renders the Easy Apply modal inside open Shadow DOM under `#interop-outlet.shadowRoot` (plus `#shadow-host-companion`); detection now pierces one level deep from those hosts (and any open `shadowRoot`) to find the dialog and fields, scoped strictly to the Additional Questions step; see project-build-progress.md.

### ✅ S7C. Indeed Apply-with-Indeed detection scoping
Same intent as S7B, applied to Indeed: real employer questions live only on `smartapply.indeed.com`'s `questions-module` step(s) (URL pattern `/beta/indeedapply/form/questions-module/questions/N`); the homepage/search results and the `resume-selection-module` step surface no real questions and must be excluded. Detection must handle multiple sequential questions pages, not just the first. Same Cover Letter carve-out/co-location rule as S7B, applied to the `questions-module` step(s).
**Done when:** only genuine `questions-module`-step fields are detected as questions on Indeed across all sequential question pages, and a co-located cover-letter field is not specially excluded.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** the homepage, search-results, or `resume-selection-module` step.

> **S7C Indeed Apply-with-Indeed detection scoping** merged to `main` (PR #21) — `packages/shared/src/adapters/indeed.ts` scopes extraction to `smartapply.indeed.com`'s `questions-module` step(s) via `INDEED_QUESTIONS_MODULE_PATH_RE`; off that host/path extraction returns zero questions. Same cover-letter co-location rule as S7B. `indeed.content.ts` reuses the exported regex for its extraction-failure heuristic; see project-build-progress.md.

> **S8 Draft Cover Letter facility** completed on branch `fm/jobibi-draft-cover-letter-s8` — the three-outcome draft/ask/refuse gate (D10) is deliberately skipped for this facility, not reused: it always attempts a draft, and the human accept/edit/discard step does the job the gate does elsewhere (nothing reaches storage unreviewed). See project-build-progress.md.

### S8. Draft Cover Letter facility
Adapter-independent facility: user pastes a job description into a textbox, Jobibi drafts a cover letter via the existing retrieval-grounded drafting pipeline (pointed at a whole cover letter instead of one question, gate skipped — see above), user explicitly accepts (stored as data, origin tracked per D13 — an AI draft accepted without edits must NOT feed the style/voice profile) or discards (no storage). Accepted drafts are stored via the existing S3b paste-ingest path so they become a retrievable `memory_chunks` document. Also drops "Upload Cover Letter" and "Upload Transcript" from the existing Upload a document picker entirely.
**Done when:** a pasted job description produces a grounded draft; accept records correct origin and stores it as a retrievable document; discard stores nothing; Upload Cover Letter/Upload Transcript are gone from the document picker.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** per-adapter cover-letter field integration (that's the carve-out logic in S7B/S7C/S8a).

### S8a. JobStreet Cover Letter detection carve-out removal
Narrowed to JobStreet only (LinkedIn/Indeed pieces folded into S7B/S7C above, since those already touch the same detection-scoping logic). The JobStreet adapter currently has a real carve-out (`isCoverLetterDraftable` check in `packages/shared/src/adapters/jobstreet.ts`) that deliberately keeps detecting a cover-letter textarea as a question field. Remove that special-casing: the JobStreet adapter should stop specially detecting/targeting a Cover Letter field as an application question, unless it's co-located with real employer questions on the same step (same co-location rule as S7B/S7C) — then leave it detected normally. The generic label-proximity fallback extractor is NOT subject to this exclusion either way.
**Done when:** JobStreet no longer specially detects a non-co-located Cover Letter field as a question; a co-located one is still detected normally.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** LinkedIn or Indeed (see S7B/S7C).

### S9. Style profile v1
Distillation job producing `style_profile` from the **voice corpus only** — `user_written` and `user_edited` answers, never `accepted_verbatim` (D13). Injected into drafting via cached system prompt; re-runs every N new answers; runs on the half-price batch tier.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** freshness clocks, proactive grilling.

## Phase 4 — Polish and premium

### S10. Grill Me + freshness clocks
Half-life per fact type; stale facts trigger a Grill Me chat session in the panel and contextual re-confirms mid-application; answers update memory.

> Smaller than in v0.1: initial fact collection already shipped in S3, so this slice is only the *refresh* loop.

### S11. Auto-Fill behind the beta flag
Insert button on copy cards for flagged testers; per-adapter fill logic (native setters + events); generic fallback fills simple text inputs only; sensitive fields structurally excluded; **low-confidence mappings disable Insert** (D16).

### S12. Privacy surface + beta caps
Export-my-data and delete-everything endpoints wired to panel settings, plus **per-answer delete** (mandatory under D12). Free-tier daily cap (size from D8 — a fairness control, not a cost control). Media-branching detection for video/upload questions offering the script-drafting session.

---

## Cross-cutting, from S5a onward

- **Decision logging.** Every gate decision records both scores, the outcome, and what the user did next. D15's retuning depends on this existing from the first shipped slice.
- **Output length discipline.** Luna runs ~2× the median output length. Every drafting call carries a schema, an explicit length instruction, and a `max_tokens` cap.

## Out of plan (tracked, not scheduled)

Workday adapter, mobile, desktop app, local-only memory mode, voice, payment rails, Chrome Web Store listing polish/marketing site, embedding-model upgrade (triggered by gate misbehaviour, not by schedule — D5c), model bake-off against Sonnet 5 / Mistral Large 3 (triggered by voice quality complaints — D5b).
